card.line: Lachish was a strong Canaanite city south of Jerusalem. Joshua captured it, and later it was a base for Assyria's attack on Judah.

moments.title: Joshua captures Lachish
moments.text: Joshua and all Israel laid siege to Lachish. The LORD delivered it into Israel's hand, and Joshua captured it on the second day. Horam king of Gezer came to help the city, but Joshua struck him down.

moments.title: King Amaziah is killed
moments.text: Men plotted against King Amaziah in Jerusalem, and he fled to Lachish. Men were sent after him, and they killed him there.

moments.title: Hezekiah pays Assyria
moments.text: Sennacherib king of Assyria attacked the fortified cities of Judah. Hezekiah sent word to him at Lachish, admitting he had done wrong. The king of Assyria demanded silver and gold, and Hezekiah paid.

moments.title: Assyria sends an army to Jerusalem
moments.text: Sennacherib and his forces besieged Lachish. From there the king of Assyria sent officers with a great army to Jerusalem, along with a message against Hezekiah and the LORD.
